title.zh: 陆路交通及相关事项法 2026（过渡规定）条例 2026
title.en: Land Transport and Related Matters Act 2026 (Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Land Transport and Related Matters Act 2026 (Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 27 February 2026.

heading.en: Driving or riding mobility vehicles without certificate of medical need

text.en:
2.—(1) Despite section 16 of the Act, sections 23I and 23J of the Active Mobility Act 2017 do not apply to, or in relation to —
(a)an individual who, between 27 February 2026 and 31 May 2026 (both dates inclusive), drives or rides a mobility vehicle on any public path without a certificate of medical need for that mobility vehicle, certifying that the individual has a medical need to drive or ride that mobility vehicle; or
(b)a person who employs or allows an individual mentioned in sub‑paragraph (a) to do an act mentioned in that sub‑paragraph.
(2) In paragraph (1), “mobility vehicle” has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Active Mobility Act 2017.
